strategy_families.structural_signature: The candidate changes wording while retaining the source paragraph jobs, conceptual grouping, order, symmetry, and cadence.
strategy_families.automatic_reject_if: The candidate can fairly be described as the old paragraph made more conversational.

strategy_families.structural_signature: A polished danger-ended/body-continues antithesis leads to an exhaustive symptom inventory and then a sentence explaining why that matters.
strategy_families.automatic_reject_if: The same three-part logic survives under different words.
surface_changes_do_not_cure: replacing the significance sentence with a casual equivalent

strategy_families.structural_signature: A neat stay-present, stop, return checklist is followed by a polished correction about deep processing.
strategy_families.automatic_reject_if: The readiness criteria remain a balanced three-item display followed by explanatory aftercare.

strategy_families.structural_signature: Three balanced alternatives present regulation, discharge, and direct processing, followed by a disclaimer that they are not program steps.
strategy_families.automatic_reject_if: The same alternative-card sequence and tidy aftercare remain, even without repeated 'Sometimes'.

strategy_families.structural_signature: Significance staging introduces a polished understand-X/still-Y contrast and ends with paired inhabiting or engulfment metaphors.
strategy_families.automatic_reject_if: The candidate preserves significance staging, mirrored clauses, or the paired metaphor architecture.
surface_changes_do_not_cure: new metaphors in the same slots

strategy_families.structural_signature: General claims or framework judgments are rewritten as personal experience despite no owner provenance for the experience.
evidence_refs: earlier rejected Somatic attempt described in referenced ChatGPT diagnosis
strategy_families.automatic_reject_if: Any general claim becomes autobiography or any observation becomes a stronger interpretation without authority.

strategy_families.structural_signature: Already-human owner wording near the changed material is counted as evidence that the new model-written connective prose was repaired.
strategy_families.automatic_reject_if: The validation attributes human quality to untouched owner language or includes it in the claimed repair scope.
surface_changes_do_not_cure: combining owner and generated spans in one score

strategy_families.structural_signature: A detector result triggers synonym, cadence, or persona tweaks before provenance, preservation, attribution, and structural recurrence have passed.
strategy_families.automatic_reject_if: Detector feedback is used before all prior gates pass or a worse result causes surface retuning instead of a new falsified-strategy entry.
